description.value: Gokudo Shabu Shabu is a Japanese-Taiwanese fusion hot pot restaurant with locations in Richmond and Burnaby, BC. Diners choose from 17 unique soup bases — including sukiyaki, satay, spicy mix, and a vegetarian broth — and cook thinly sliced meats and fresh vegetables at the table in a customizable, interactive format. The restaurant emphasizes sustainable and locally sourced ingredients alongside house-crafted sauces developed by the founder's wife.
